response.text: Two matches share the same middle number and amount across different vendors. I'll look at those more closely, along with the rent invoices and invoice dates against periods.

arguments.sql: SELECT i.*, h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."MEMO" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (270,657,92,349,802,803,801,1) ORDER BY i."INV_ID"

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_DT", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."STAT_CD" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE i."INV_DT"<>h."POST_DT" OR i."INV_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND (h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT" OR h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT") ORDER BY 1
